TABLE.NAME: local_elediaai_sources_course
TABLE.COMMENT: Tracks whether each course is currently represented in the RAG index, so that toggling a course's ingestion marking can trigger a one-time re-index (on enable) or purge (on disable) instead of acting on every course edit.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course.

FIELD.NAME: ingested
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when at least one of the course's documents is in the index. This is what consumers such as the tutor ask before grounding answers in course sources.

FIELD.NAME: pending
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when documents are still outstanding. Independent of ingested: a partly ingested course has both set, so the tutor can already use the sources while the reconcile keeps working.

FIELD.NAME: sink
FIELD.COMMENT: Id of the destination the course was last ingested into. Empty when not ingested.

FIELD.NAME: embeddingmodel
FIELD.COMMENT: Embedding model reported by that destination at the time. Empty when the destination reports none.

FIELD.NAME: tenant
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant id derived from wwwroot at the time. Empty when not ingested.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Last state change.

TABLE.NAME: local_elediaai_sources_cm
TABLE.COMMENT: Explicit per-activity ingestion decisions. No row means untouched: the site-wide activitydefault mode decides. Deletions from the index are only ever driven by an explicit exclusion, so switching the mode never touches existing content.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course, for bulk reads and course-level cleanup.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course module the decision is about.

FIELD.NAME: included
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = explicitly included, 0 = explicitly excluded.

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Who made the decision.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: When the decision was last changed.

TABLE.NAME: local_elediaai_sources_cmstate
TABLE.COMMENT: Site-local index truth per course module: what was last sent where, under which source id and with which content hash. Absence of a row means: not in the index. Deliberately separate from the decisions table, whose rows mean 'a teacher decided'.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course, for bulk reads and course-level cleanup.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course module.

FIELD.NAME: sink
FIELD.COMMENT: Destination id the content was sent to.

FIELD.NAME: sourceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Module-level source id at ingest time; freezes the tenant so later deletes stay exact.

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha1 over the final document tuples; empty until a successful upsert.

FIELD.NAME: laststatus
FIELD.COMMENT: success or error.

FIELD.NAME: attempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Consecutive failed attempts. Reset by a success. Once it reaches the retry limit the module is skipped until a forced reindex, so one broken document cannot stall the course every reconcile run.

FIELD.NAME: lasterror
FIELD.COMMENT: Last error message, when laststatus is error.

FIELD.NAME: timeingested
FIELD.COMMENT: When content last reached the index.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Last row change.

KEY.NAME: cmid
KEY.COMMENT: One state row per course module.
